templates.text: CCPD reports checkpoint delays across {district}. Commuters are advised to remain patient and observable.
Halcyon Dynamics shares rose today on news of a 'Cinder City revitalization portfolio'. Analysts call the portfolio 'several entire neighborhoods'.
Berth inspections continue at Ashfall Docks. The Syndicate declines to comment, as is traditional.
The Cinder Refinery flare entered its thirty-ninth consecutive year of operation. Officials describe it as 'iconic'.
Police seek a suspect described only as 'cooperative until cornered'. Residents are reminded that cornering is police work.
St. Ember's bell returns to service after 40 years. Kiln Row reports mixed feelings and one proposal.
An active police operation is underway near {district}. If you hear sirens, mind your business; if you hear two sirens, mind it faster.
Crowe Credit Co. reminds borrowers that 'every day is a good day to settle'. The reminder was printed in pencil.
Unsanctioned boxing continues at an undisclosed yard. Bookmakers describe the odds as 'emotional'.
Rain expected through the week. The Department of Streets reminds drivers that puddles are, legally, still streets.

greet: Eli Vane. Your ma would've loved this weather.
You look like trouble with good posture.
Walk safe, Vane. The street's got moods.
fear: Hey— hey, I didn't see nothing!
Not me, please, I pay my rent ON TIME—
Somebody call the— no, no, don't look at me like that!
combat: I'm filming this for my cousin!
gunshots: Not again, I JUST paid for this window!
rain: Rain again. City smells like pennies.
Good night for ghosts and bad decisions.
night: Heard singing from the refinery. Never ask twice.
police: Blues are sweeping. Keep your hands boring.
Checkpoint on the arterial. I'd walk the alleys.
Okoro's crew. She's fair. Fair's not the same as kind.
work: Manifest's short two crates and my neck's short one patience.
Tide's out; the gulls own the quay now.
vendor: Hot! Hot and cheap! Mostly hot!
Two for one after midnight, friend!
Buy something or buy nothing, but stand somewhere else!
young: You seen Dex's new paint? Criminal. Positively.
Yard 4's taking bets again, fyi. Fyi!
My cousin says Halcyon's tower hums at night. My cousin says lots of things.
kind: Bless you, child. Eat something warm.
The shelter could use hands, not money. Hands stay longer.
St. Ember's door's never locked. Neither's mine.
drunk: I'm FINE. The street moved, not me.
One more and I'm a new man. A worse one, but new.
Sing it with me— no? Rude.
guard: Badge's decorative, patience isn't. Move along.
Halcyon property ends at the curb. Mostly.
I've worked twelve hours. Test me gently.
music: Coins keep the song going, friend!
This one's for the night shift!
Request? Requests cost double after midnight!
tourist: Is that the refinery? It's BEAUTIFUL at dusk, honestly.
Our guide said don't talk to locals. So, briefly: hello.
Where's the good view? The paid one or the true one?
city: Quarter's tight this month. Everything's a quarter now.
Halcyon bought my building. Rent's 'market rate'. Market for whom?
Keep your head down and your steps quick. Classic Furnace advice.
thank: You didn't have to do that. Won't forget it.
Owe you one, Vane. Small cities keep tallies.
Ruth was right about you. Told her so.
hostile: Crowe's people ask about you. I don't answer. Mostly.
You're the Vane with the brother trouble. Charming.
Syndicate colors on YOU? Bold. Stupid, but bold.
busted: Told you the blues remember faces!
There goes another one through the system.
Hope the cell's warm, friend. They never are.
respect: Yard 4 champ walks among us. Saw the bout. Brutal. Beautiful.
Heard you stood at the plaza. People talk. People remember.
Gunnar says you're alright. From Gunnar, that's a medal.
